outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating illumination-overhead percentages for different exposure times using bar-length icons; each bar represents a single computed percentage value rather than an average of replicate measurements, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.

Panel B is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded mean±s.e.m. bands. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying raw points would make the curves unreadable.
Panel C is a scatter/line plot of ΔROS versus exposure time with a fitted curve; scatter plots are exempt from this check as the plotted points already constitute the data.

Panel D consists of line plots showing individual cell migration tracks (each line is a single cell's trajectory). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement, and here the data are already shown at single-cell resolution.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed, and individual cell data points (black dots) are overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (Mitotracker/Paxillin/Merge), not a quantitative summary plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel G shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not an averaged data plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not an averaged data plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points overlay requirement.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points overlay requirement.
